base_template: Write a summary of an audit at {{company_name}}. The {{dept_1}} team (VLAN {{vlan1_id}}) should not have access to {{dept_3}} (VLAN {{vlan3_id}}), which stores sensitive {{data_type}}. Use VLANs to ensure isolation between all three departments.

company_name.instruction: Generate a unique tech or finance firm name

data_type.instruction: Pick one: Employee PII or Financial Records

vlan1_id.instruction: Generate a VLAN ID between 10 and 50

vlan2_id.instruction: Generate a VLAN ID between 51 and 100

vlan3_id.instruction: Generate a VLAN ID between 101 and 150

vlan1_ip.instruction: Generate a private IP in 10.x.x.x, last octet between 50-150 (avoid .1 and .10). Must be in a different /24 than vlan2_ip and vlan3_ip

vlan2_ip.instruction: Generate a private IP in 172.16.x.x, last octet between 50-150 (avoid .1 and .10). Must be in a different /24 than vlan1_ip and vlan3_ip

vlan3_ip.instruction: Generate a private IP in 192.168.x.x, last octet between 50-150 (avoid .1 and .10). Must be in a different /24 than vlan1_ip and vlan2_ip

expected_solution: Create VLANs on Switch, configure subinterfaces on R1 with encapsulation dot1Q, and apply inbound ACLs to block dept_1 (VLAN1) from reaching dept_3 (VLAN3).
